dushinan,Character 2: Ashu, the dream restorer of the concrete forest
Core setting: During the day, he is an ordinary landscape designer, while at night, he is a wild plant artist wandering in abandoned corners of the city. Secretly creating miniature "ecological patches" using moss, succulents, and weather resistant steel in distribution boxes, bridge piers, and wall cracks to repair the cold cracks in the city.

Hairstyle: Chestnut natural curly short hair, slightly disheveled by himself, resembling a bird's nest. Wearing a pair of black framed glasses, with green electrical tape wrapped around the legs of the glasses.

Clothes & Accessories:

The khaki colored engineer vest is the main body, filled with various tool pockets: containing mini spray cans, small shovels, plant nutrients, and a roll of hemp rope.

Wear a gray old T-shirt with a fuzzy plant map printed inside.

Wear a pair of olive green jogging pants with scattered dirt marks underneath, combining comfort and maneuverability.

Shoes: A pair of high top dark green waterproof hiking shoes with fluorescent orange laces to ensure safe night work
